The vendor providing **CopyReadyNow** at **copyreadynow.com** is **VIRTPRODUCTGROUP LTD**. 

### Evidence:
* **Operating Entity Profile:** SaaS company tracking records identify **VIRTPRODUCTGROUP LTD** (based in London, UK) as the company operating `copyreadynow.com`:
  > *"Create content pieces with great accuracy, thanks to our highly-targeted AI-powered copywriting tool. CopyReadyNow is designed to help tech marketers and writers produce content, without the 'written by AI' feel. ... copyreadynow.com"*
* **Leadership and Developers:** VIRTPRODUCTGROUP LTD is led by CEO Tim Meredith, who developed and launched CopyReadyNow alongside co-founders Jim Freeman and Kateryna Novozhylova (also the team behind the agency Fractional Teams / Next Generation ICT Ltd).
